name: 16a online softmax rescaling
title: Online softmax over two tiles
subtitle: One query row: scores 1, 2 | 4, 3 and values 10, 20 | 30, 40, seen one tile at a time

steps.caption: Step 1. Tile 1 has scores 1 and 2, so the running max is 2. The weights e^(1-2) = 0.368 and 1 give a sum of 1.3679 and a weighted sum of 23.679.
Step 2. Tile 2 brings a score of 4, a new max. Everything stored so far is multiplied by e^(2-4) = 0.1353, so the sum becomes 0.1851 and the weighted sum 3.205.
Step 3. Tile 2 adds weights e^0 = 1 and e^(-1) = 0.368 with values 30 and 40, so the sum becomes 1.5530 and the weighted sum 47.920.
Step 4. Dividing gives 47.920 / 1.5530 = 30.856, exactly the output of a softmax over all four scores at once, whose weights are 0.032, 0.087, 0.644 and 0.237.
Step 5. Skipping the rescale leaves tile 1 measured from its own max of 2, so the sums are 2.7358 and 68.394 and the output is 25.0, as if the two tiles counted equally.
